semiconductor_relevance: High — Euris GmbH supplies a range of equipment and consumables specifically for semiconductor manufacturing and research.
summary: Euris GmbH is a European distribution company that provides a comprehensive portfolio of equipment and consumables for semiconductor and photovoltaics sectors. Their offerings include wet processing systems, grinding and polishing tools, metrology equipment, and vacuum chamber cleaning supplies, supported by a dedicated service team.
capabilities: Wet processing systems for wafer cleaning
Metrology equipment for resistivity and lifetime measurement
